snippet.title: Thirsty Princess - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Compete with friends in fast-paced local multiplayer battles to win your princesses favour. Dash, throw, steal, and drink your way to victory in this chaotic 2-4 player indie party game!

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3978360/Thirsty_Princess/

If you enjoyed this trailer, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe — it helps a ton!


Follow the development of Thirsty Princess:

Fat Pint Games Website: http://www.fatpintgames.com.au
Discord: https://discord.gg/PVVXumar3e
Bluesky: https://fatpintgames.bsky.social
